sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: Bramble Stone Tumblers: Rattling tumbler devices in the Lucent River that smooth stones for Bramble armor and scare travelers who do not know the sound.

sections.title: Mechanics
items: Player Safe: Players can inspect, handle, keep, trade, reveal, or earn Bramble Stone Tumblers when it is present in the fiction.
Gm Only: Use the roll only when the player's method, stakes, and consequence are concrete.

No Roll Reveals: Surface read: Rattling tumbler devices in the Lucent River that smooth stones for Bramble armor and scare travelers who do not know the sound. Give obvious visible facts freely; roll for meaning, risk, leverage, cost, or a hidden angle.

Add an extra benefit that follows from the fiction. Success with Hope: the PC gets what they wanted and gains Hope. Keep the position clean or generous. Success with Fear: the PC gets what they wanted, but the GM gains Fear and introduces a cost, complication, or pressure. Fear Spends: Reveal who benefits from the current situation. Make the cost personal without closing off player agency.
